content.text: undiagnosed abnorm genital bleed; breast CA or a Hx of breast CA (except selected pts treated for metastatic dz); estrogen-dependent neoplasia; active or past DVT or PE; active or past arterial thromboembolic dz (eg, CVA, MI); hepatic impairment or dz; protein C, protein S or antithrombin deficiency or other thrombophilia.

unopposed estrogen raises the risk of endometrial CA in a woman w a uterus. Estrogen-alone therapy should ⍉be used to prevent CVD or dementia; WHIMS found a higher risk of probable dementia in postmenopausal women 65 and older on estrogen alone.
